title: Correct Step 4's causal claim: border removal is not what discards the body
intent: VECTORIZER_WORKING_RECIPE.md Step 4 states that _remove_page_borders_early() 'removes the body along with the frame' and calls that 'the mechanism behind the page-border-only result'. Instrumented runs on 2026-09-19 measured the opposite: on the cuatro that function went 7,368 -> 7,368 and removed nothing, and on Gibson L-00 it missed the real page border entirely. The body is discarded one stage later, by the eligibility block at edge_to_dxf.py:941-950. The practical instruction (strip borders after extraction, geometrically) is unchanged and still correct; only its stated cause is replaced. Documentation only: one Markdown file, no code.
behavior_change: None. One modified Markdown file under docs/handoffs/ plus this manifest. No code, configuration, workflow or test is touched.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Replaces the final paragraph of Step 4. Keeps 'Never do this before extraction' and the geometric rule, and replaces the false causal claim with the measured one: the eligibility block at edge_to_dxf.py:941-950 discards the body, via too_small at :943 on the cuatro (cv2.contourArea measures ENCLOSED area, and a stroke-traced outline encloses only its own line width -- 1,437 lower-bout contours, 0 eligible) and via child_contour at :947 on L-00 (rejecting the page border does not unparent what sits inside it -- 0 eligible, run fails). Adds a lineage note stating the step concerns edge_to_dxf.py only and that vectorizer_phase3.py line numbers do not apply.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: The claim being corrected is live in the document this PR's parent (#385) merged. It is the one deferred item of three that actively misdirects: a reader following it goes to _remove_page_borders_early, a function measured to have done nothing wrong on either plan. The other two deferred items under-specify rather than mislead and are filed separately.

commands_run: Instrumented extract_blueprint_to_dxf(isolate_body=True) on the cuatro with _remove_page_borders_early wrapped at runtime, 2026-09-19: input 7,368 contours, output 7,368. No repo file edited.
Same instrumentation on Gibson-L0-IN.png: the page-size contour reached _build_hierarchy_nodes at area_ratio 0.962 and was labelled too_large, not page_border, so _is_page_border did not fire on it.
Per-stage census on the cuatro: 7,368 findContours -> 7,368 after border removal -> 7,332 nodes -> 3 eligible. Refusals: 7,328 too_small, 1 child_contour.
Lower-bout region on the cuatro: 1,437 contours overlapping, 0 eligible, 1,437 refused too_small. Perimeter confirmed traced by rendering every arc >=150px coloured by gate verdict.
L-00: 3,053 contours, 0 eligible, run returns 'No valid contours found in edge image'. Largest contour 1815x1365 px encloses 0.276 of the raster (55x the 0.005 floor) and is refused as child_contour.
